usage_rules: READ-ONLY reference. Do not mutate at runtime.
All three verification zones must pass before SKU is marked CLEAN.
Zone 1: sub_brand_visual_rules вЂ” triggers matched against product_name.
Zone 2: photosensitive_compounds вЂ” active_ingredient matched against triggers; if match AND geometry is BOTTLE/VIAL/AMPOULE/DROPPER/BLISTER в†’ enforce material_override.
Zone 3: dosage_display вЂ” if value is null/N/A/empty в†’ flag SKU for DailyMed/FDA lookup; block render until resolved.
Brand Identity Retention: same brand в†’ same base palette. Sub-brand differentiation is surface/finish/accent ONLY.

zone_1_sub_brand.description: Match product_name against sub_brand_visual_rules triggers в†’ inject visual overrides into .md passport
zone_1_sub_brand.fail_condition: No matching trigger found в†’ default to original_or_base ruleset

zone_2_photosensitivity.description: Match active_ingredient against photosensitive_compounds triggers в†’ enforce material_override if geometry matches
zone_2_photosensitivity.fail_condition: Geometry mismatch (e.g. compound requires VIAL but passport has BOTTLE with clear glass) в†’ hard override

zone_3_dosage_display.description: Validate dosage_display field is not null/N/A/empty. SKUs 347-349 currently blocked.
zone_3_dosage_display.fail_condition: dosage_display is null, 'N/A', or empty string
zone_3_dosage_display.resolution: Pull real market value from DailyMed API or FDA drug label database в†’ write to passport в†’ re-run verification
zone_3_dosage_display.target_state: All 389 SKUs pass with concrete dosage values

sub_brand_visual_rules._principle: Brand Identity Retention: base palette is preserved across all sub-brands. Surface treatment, finish, and accent differentiation ONLY. Same primary hex across a line = CORRECT. Penalty ONLY for WCAG 4.5:1 text-background contrast failure.
sub_brand_visual_rules._color_as_sole_identifier: PROHIBITED вЂ” color cannot be the only differentiator. Must always pair with text.

PDE5_inhibitors.degradation_risk: Moderate light sensitivity. PVC-ALU blister standard; premium generic SKUs upgrade to Alu-PVC for brand signaling.
PDE5_inhibitors.material_render_spec: 4-tablet or 8-tablet aluminum foil-backed PVC-PVDC blister pack in small folded carton with blue accent band

injectable_anabolic_steroids.degradation_risk: Oxidative photodegradation of steroid nucleus + oil vehicle rancidification under UV
injectable_anabolic_steroids.material_render_spec: 10mL amber borosilicate glass injection vial, bromobutyl rubber stopper, aluminum crimp cap 20mm, flip-off cap, multi-dose, pharmaceutical oil suspension
injectable_anabolic_steroids.usp_reference: USP <660> Type I вЂ” highest hydrolytic resistance; amber per USP <671> spectral transmission в‰¤10% at 290вЂ“450nm
injectable_anabolic_steroids.ai_prompt_trigger: 10mL amber borosilicate glass injection vial with aluminum crimp cap and flip-off cap, multi-dose, pharmaceutical oil suspension, studio lighting 3/4 isometric view

injectable_hormones_peptides.degradation_risk: Protein aggregation and denaturation under UV light. Liquid hormone formulations degrade under UV. Amber glass blocks 290-450nm per USP <671>.
injectable_hormones_peptides.material_render_spec: Amber glass Type I vial, UV-protective coating, rubber stopper, aluminum crimp cap. Note: flint (clear) glass acceptable ONLY when stored in opaque outer carton at all times per labeling.
injectable_hormones_peptides.usp_reference: USP <660> Type I; insulin monograph; EMA insulin guidance
injectable_hormones_peptides.ai_prompt_trigger: 10mL amber borosilicate glass vial with rubber stopper and aluminum crimp cap, pharmaceutical injectable hormone, in branded opaque carton, 3/4 isometric studio render

epinephrine_catecholamines.degradation_risk: Catecholamines oxidize rapidly under light вЂ” produce adrenochrome and quinone byproducts, clinically inactive and potentially toxic
epinephrine_catecholamines.material_render_spec: Amber glass autoinjector or vial Type I, UV-protective packaging. EpiPen: opaque outer carton mandatory.
epinephrine_catecholamines.usp_reference: USP <660> Type I; USP <1> Epinephrine monograph light protection requirement
epinephrine_catecholamines.ai_prompt_trigger: 1mL amber glass ampoule with printed label, epinephrine injectable, colored break-ring, studio 3/4 isometric pharmaceutical render

ophthalmic_drops_prostaglandins.degradation_risk: Prostaglandin analogs undergo rapid hydrolytic and photolytic degradation. Fluoroquinolones and aminoglycosides also photodegrade. Must be stored 2вЂ“8В°C prior to opening.
ophthalmic_drops_prostaglandins.material_render_spec: Opaque white LDPE dropper bottle with snap-cap or opaque amber HDPE dropper, light-protective. LDPE nozzle tip with tamper-evident PP overcap.
ophthalmic_drops_prostaglandins.usp_reference: USP <661> LDPE light transmission compliance required
ophthalmic_drops_prostaglandins.ai_prompt_trigger: 5mL opaque white LDPE ophthalmic dropper bottle with tamper-evident overcap, pharmaceutical eye drops, 3/4 isometric studio render

nitroglycerin_class.degradation_risk: Nitroglycerin is volatile and photolabile вЂ” loses potency rapidly in clear glass or PVC. UV degradation within minutes in clear glass.
nitroglycerin_class.material_render_spec: Dark amber borosilicate glass Type I vial or amber glass tablet bottle, light-protective, original glass container, child-resistant PP closure with desiccant liner
nitroglycerin_class.usp_reference: USP <660> Type I (vial) / Type III amber (tablet bottle); USP <659> tight light-resistant container
nitroglycerin_class.ai_prompt_trigger: amber glass pharmaceutical tablet bottle with child-resistant cap, small oval form, tight container, 3/4 isometric studio view

sodium_nitroprusside.degradation_risk: Decomposition begins within minutes of light exposure. Diluted solutions must be wrapped in opaque sleeve.
sodium_nitroprusside.material_render_spec: Amber glass vial Type I with opaque aluminum foil overwrap sleeve. Highly light-sensitive.

furosemide_loop_diuretics.degradation_risk: Photodegradation follows first-order kinetics under fluorescent and UV light. Amber glass provides complete protection (PubMed 8696779).
furosemide_loop_diuretics.material_render_spec: 2mL amber borosilicate glass ampoule or vial, heat-sealed or rubber stopper with crimp cap
furosemide_loop_diuretics.usp_reference: USP <660> Type I; confirmed by peer-reviewed photodegradation studies
furosemide_loop_diuretics.ai_prompt_trigger: 2mL amber borosilicate glass ampoule with colored break ring, pharmaceutical injectable solution, studio 3/4 isometric render

retinoids_oral.degradation_risk: Highly photolabile вЂ” rapid isomerization and oxidation under visible and UV light. Require complete light exclusion.
retinoids_oral.material_render_spec: Cold-formed aluminum-aluminum blister вЂ” PA_25Вµm / AL_45Вµm / PVC_60Вµm base + AL_20Вµm lidding foil. Full moisture and light barrier.
retinoids_oral.usp_reference: USP <659> light-resistant container; EMA QRD mandates opaque primary pack
retinoids_oral.ai_prompt_trigger: cold-formed aluminum-aluminum blister pack with opaque matte silver foil cavities and printed aluminum lidding, pharmaceutical tablets visible at edge, 3/4 isometric studio render

ergotamine_class.degradation_risk: Ergot alkaloids are moisture and light sensitive. Alu-Alu provides near-zero MVTR and full light block.
ergotamine_class.material_render_spec: Aluminum-Aluminum (Alu-Alu) cold-form blister вЂ” full moisture and light barrier. Matte silver-grey opaque forming sheet with silver foil lidding вЂ” no transparency.

hormonal_contraceptives_HRT.degradation_risk: Synthetic estrogens and progestins photodegrade; moisture also a concern.
hormonal_contraceptives_HRT.material_render_spec: 28-day calendar blister pack with aluminum foil backing and PVC-PVDC cavities containing small round tablets
hormonal_contraceptives_HRT.usp_reference: USP <659> moisture-resistant, light-resistant; EMA QRD requires calendar blister for cycle adherence
hormonal_contraceptives_HRT.ai_prompt_trigger: 28-day calendar blister pack with aluminum foil backing and PVC-PVDC cavities containing small round tablets, hormone therapy packaging, 3/4 isometric studio render

amphotericin_antifungal_injectables.degradation_risk: Polyene macrolide вЂ” degrades under visible light. Lyophilized powder form requires amber protection.
amphotericin_antifungal_injectables.material_render_spec: 20mL amber glass lyophilized powder vial, lyophilization rubber stopper 20mm, aluminum crimp cap
amphotericin_antifungal_injectables.usp_reference: USP <660> Type I; USP <1> monograph for Amphotericin B
amphotericin_antifungal_injectables.ai_prompt_trigger: 20mL amber glass lyophilized powder vial with aluminum crimp cap, pharmaceutical antifungal, studio isometric render

light_sensitive_antibiotics.degradation_risk: Liquid antibiotic formulations require amber containers. Tablet forms in standard blister acceptable.
light_sensitive_antibiotics.material_render_spec: Amber HDPE or Type II amber glass bottle, child-resistant cap

vitamin_D_fat_soluble.degradation_risk: Fat-soluble vitamins oxidize and photodegrade. Amber glass or opaque HDPE mandatory for liquid forms; Alu-Alu blister for solid forms.
vitamin_D_fat_soluble.material_render_spec_liquid: 30mL amber glass dropper bottle with aluminum screw cap
vitamin_D_fat_soluble.material_render_spec_solid: White opaque HDPE pharmaceutical bottle with child-resistant polypropylene cap and tamper-evident band
vitamin_D_fat_soluble.usp_reference: USP <660> Type III for liquids; USP <661> HDPE for solids

inhaler_beta2_agonists.degradation_risk: HFA propellant and drug formulation degrade under UV. Aluminum canisters provide intrinsic full light barrier.
inhaler_beta2_agonists.material_render_spec: Opaque colored plastic inhaler housing with aluminum pressurized canister inside. Push-button plastic actuator in blue or grey. L-shaped mouthpiece.
inhaler_beta2_agonists.ai_prompt_trigger: pressurized metered-dose inhaler with opaque blue plastic actuator and aluminum canister, L-shaped mouthpiece, pharmaceutical asthma inhaler, 3/4 isometric studio render

brand_identity_retention._principle: Same brand в†’ same base palette. Sub-brand differentiation is surface/finish/accent ONLY вЂ” not palette replacement.
brand_identity_retention.color_consistency_rule: Identical primary hex across a product line is CORRECT behavior вЂ” Brand Identity Retention.
brand_identity_retention.penalty_rule: NO confidence penalty for same-brand palette sharing. Penalty ONLY for WCAG 4.5:1 text-background contrast failure.
sub_brand_hierarchy: 1. Master brand anchor (logo, palette) вЂ” unchanged across all sub-brands
2. Sub-brand finish tier (matte/gloss/metallic) вЂ” differentiates series visually
3. Accent color вЂ” single contrasting highlight per series edition
4. Dosage number prominence вЂ” scales with potency tier (Forte > Professional > Standard)
